description: This course addresses the relationship between music and society by considering questions like, "Why do I like the music that I like?" and "Is there such a thing as bad music?" Using a vigorous  musicological framework, students will engage in readings, in-class discussions, produce podcasts and/or blog posts, and produce a final research paper to examine the concepts of musical value, popularity, genre, and taste. Prerequisite: MUSIC 141 or permission of instructor.
